authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states from live G05 v1 exactByteIntent and pairedWorkload. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a numeric cap. It does not invent a D-006 unit. It does not mint Rust-as-core. It does not score analyze or a consented probe as the workload. It does not invent an occupancy leftover-join. It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not close OBL-2. It does not execute G05. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of G05 fixture authoring by naming initial states drawn from live G05 v1 exactByteIntent and pairedWorkload, with NOT-AUTHORED markers attached to those named states.

g05v1.role: Live G05 occupancy. artifactPathWhenAuthored. exactByteIntent and pairedWorkload are quoted.

whatIsAuthored: Named initial states drawn from live G05 v1 exactByteIntent: four D-002 platforms × four published deltas (download, install, start, RSS); pairedWorkload coreOnly/componentEnabled; host status/inventory command; 21-pair start/RSS observations; exact download/install bytes; no numeric cap. No fixture bytes. No invented cap. No Rust-as-core.
